usage: Feat choice for chargen or level-up.

srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength by 1. If you hit with a melee attack while wielding a Shield, you can Bonus Action shove (push or prone; target Strength save). If you succeed on a Dexterity save that would halve damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage instead.
